Thomas Eriksen  
(555) 123-4567 | thomas.eriksen@nexacorp.com | Austin, TX  

**Professional Summary**  
A seasoned frontend architect with a decade of enterprise experience, shaping scalable React ecosystems and mentoring cross-functional teams. Known for driving performance gains through strategic tooling and leading state management overhauls that reduced bundle sizes by 30%. My focus lies in crafting maintainable TypeScript abstractions and leveraging Next.js to deliver high-traffic applications with minimal latency.  

**Technical Skills**  
- **React**: Spearheaded component architecture for a global SaaS platform, reducing re-render cycles by 40% via custom hooks. Mentored 8+ junior engineers on best practices for componentization and accessibility.  
- **TypeScript**: Central to all new frontend initiatives, enforcing type safety in legacy codebases and reducing runtime errors by 25% at VirtuSoft.  
- **Next.js**: Engineered the core routing layer for NexaCorp’s flagship product, enabling server-side rendering for 95% of user interactions.  
- **State Management**: Redesigned global state patterns at Aegis Systems, replacing Redux with Zustand to cut boilerplate and improve developer velocity.  
- **Web Performance**: Implemented lazy loading and code splitting strategies, boosting Time to Interactive (TTI) by 50% for a high-traffic enterprise app.  
- **Browser DevTools**: Diagnosed and resolved critical performance bottlenecks in production apps, including memory leaks in a real-time collaboration tool.  
- **REST API Design**: Collaborated with backend teams to standardize API responses, reducing redundant data transfers and improving client-side efficiency.  
- **Redux/Zustand**: Optimized state workflows in a complex dashboard application, cutting initial load time by 35% through selective hydration.  

**Professional Experience**  
**Staff Frontend Engineer** | NexaCorp | 2022–Present  
- Led the migration of a monolithic React app to a microfrontend architecture, improving deployment frequency by 2x and reducing rollback incidents by 70%.  
- Designed a custom state management layer for a real-time analytics dashboard, enabling live data updates without full page reloads.  
- Spearheaded performance audits for 5+ high-traffic pages, achieving a 40% reduction in critical render path delays.  

**Lead Frontend Architect** | Aegis Systems | 2017–2022  
- Transitioned the team from manual CI/CD pipelines to automated deployment workflows, cutting release cycles from weeks to hours.  
- Built a centralized state management framework using Zustand, reducing redundant state duplication across 12+ microservices.  
- Orchestrated a Next.js rewrite of the company’s public-facing portal, increasing server-side rendering efficiency by 60%.  

**Senior Frontend Engineer** | VirtuSoft | 2014–2017  
- Developed a reusable UI library for internal tools, saving 200+ hours in custom component development across teams.  
- Collaborated with backend engineers to optimize API payload structures, reducing data transfer by 40% for a customer management system.  
- Introduced browser DevTools-based performance monitoring, identifying and resolving critical layout thrashing issues.  

**Junior Developer** | TechNova Solutions | 2010–2014  
- Built early prototypes for a B2B analytics platform, laying the groundwork for its eventual Next.js-based rewrite.  
- Contributed to a legacy React app’s refactoring, modernizing its architecture to support TypeScript and modular components.  

**Projects**  
- **NexaCorp Analytics Dashboard** | Next.js + Zustand |  
  - Designed a state-driven UI for real-time KPI tracking, eliminating the need for full page reloads.  
  - Reduced initial load time by 35% through code splitting and lazy loading.  
- **Aegis Systems Microfrontend Initiative** | React + Webpack |  
  - Created a shared UI library with 15+ reusable components, cutting duplication across 8+ projects.  
  - Implemented a centralized state management system, improving developer onboarding time by 50%.  
- **VirtuSoft Customer Portal Rewrite** | Next.js + TypeScript |  
  - Led a complete rebuild of the portal, increasing SSR efficiency and reducing client-side JavaScript by 40%.  

**Education**  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | University of Oslo | 2010
